description: Âge des conduites du réseau d'eau potable is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Région des Pays de la Loire. Number of kilometres of water pipe laid per year (since 1950) Year OF POSE year of installation, SOM sum of driving lengths laid per year. Coverage: Région des Pays de la Loire. The portal shows the English title as "Age of drinking water mains" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Région des Pays de la Loire. Its keywords include environnement, urbanisme-logement, eau, eau-assainissement, eau-potable. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
